# Each write of each act, refused one at a time on a fresh page. A block: the write and the
# answer; the requests that followed it; each run of text that appeared on the page (container,
# innermost element); the sheet; the page's message state; any rejection the page left unhandled.

## Part popover: + PART-12 (on a fresh page)
# writes, in order: PUT /api/processes/1/payloads
### PUT /api/processes/1/payloads  ←  400 {"error"} (writeError)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-partlist div.none.pd-partnote: Could not add PART-12: the Edge refused it
    sheet: closed
    state: partPop.note="Could not add PART-12: the Edge refused it"
    unhandled rejection: none
### PUT /api/processes/1/payloads  ←  500, no body (chi Recoverer)
    then: nothing
    new text: #pd-partlist div.none.pd-partnote: Could not add PART-12: the server refused it (500)
    sheet: closed
    state: partPop.note="Could not add PART-12: the server refused it (500)"
    unhandled rejection: none
### PUT /api/processes/1/payloads  ←  no answer (fetch rejects: TypeError "Failed to fetch")
    then: nothing
    new text: none
    sheet: closed
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: TypeError: Failed to fetch (body data-pd-error set to its message)
### PUT /api/processes/1/payloads  ←  session lapsed (303 to /login, 200 text/html, for it and every admin call after)
    then: GET /api/processes/1/composer · POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview
    new text: #pd-root span.t: PART-12
    new text: #pd-svg text.partlbl: PART-12
    new text: #pd-postbl span.t: PART-12
    new text: #pd-posbox span.t: PART-12
    new text: #pd-bar div.h.bad: 1 to fix
    new text: #pd-bar div.d: 1 part needs a position — PART-1 — drop each on a position, or take it off this flow. · note: STG_1 is staged at by 2 positions (POS_A3, POS_A5); STG_2 is staged at by 3 positions (POS_A4, POS_A5, POS_A6)
    new text: #pd-bar button.pd-chip: Take PART-1 off this flow
    new text: #pd-bar div.prov.dirty: Unsaved changes
    sheet: closed
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
